slow_drift_model.name: linear_inclusion_probability_drift
slow_drift_model.profile: linearly spaced probabilities over every calendar-ordered draw, scaled so the two half means differ by the registered effect

multiplicity: Holm step-down across exactly ten primary decisions
power_interval: two-sided Clopper-Pearson with Bonferroni allocation over 240 registered grid points

classification_rule.candidate_signal: Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05, candidate eligible, effect confidence set excludes practical null, and sensitivity direction is consistent
classification_rule.no_detectable_signal: not candidate_signal and simultaneous 95 percent power lower bound at the practical boundary is at least 0.80
classification_rule.indeterminate: all remaining cases; explicitly not proof of randomness

formal_network_policy: no network access or dependency downloads after readiness begins
